synthetic_self_test.scope: Synthetic circles only; no Liber Primus source image was processed.

findings.finding: Only three predefined target ROIs (pages 24, 40, 73) are processed.
findings.evidence: PAGE_CONFIG and run() loop; this is a target-group extractor, not a corpus-wide detector.
findings.next_step: Do not use this script to claim all manuscript dot groups were searched.

findings.finding: Git blob SHA-1 and 2400×3600 dimensions are checked before measurement.
findings.next_step: Retain these guards; execute only after exact bytes are available.

findings.finding: Components that fail the dot-like filter are discarded, not emitted to an audit table; comments imply broader candidate reporting.
findings.next_step: Modify extractor to log all components with accepted/rejected status and rejection reasons.

findings.finding: pairwise_signature() divides distances by the median; workbook Cluster Signatures v1.2 says distances are normalized by RMS pairwise distance.
findings.evidence: pairwise_signature() near top of script vs workbook methodology.
findings.next_step: Do not compare script outputs numerically with workbook signatures unless normalization is unified.

findings.finding: Random points in a rectangle ignore real manuscript marks, layouts, copied ornament, component detection, and target-selection procedure. Script can emit empirical p-values despite its own caveat.
findings.next_step: Disable inferential interpretation; use only as software smoke-test or historical exploratory diagnostic.

findings.finding: Cross-threshold centroids are paired greedily by nearest distance, not via globally optimal assignment; in crowded ROIs this can create mismatches.
findings.next_step: Use a minimum-cost bipartite assignment and preserve unmatched candidates.

findings.finding: Area, width, height, aspect, and fill cutoffs are tuned to solid circular marks; irregular, touching, faded, or small marks are excluded before any corpus-level comparison.
findings.next_step: For corpus survey, retain every component and classify later; calibrate on labeled controls.

findings.finding: Synthetic self-test passed for thresholds 40, 60, 80, 100 with five synthetic circles and zero rounded-center error.
findings.next_step: Validates a narrow component-extraction behavior only; not source images, JPEG decoding, ROIs, or cipher relevance.

findings.finding: This script uses Pillow Image.convert("L"), whereas recorded centroid sheet attributes values to a separate JavaScript baseline-JPEG luma decoder.
findings.evidence: Pillow conversion in run(); Decoder Crosscheck v1.2.
findings.next_step: Re-run both decoders on identical verified bytes; compare luma arrays and component centroids.

findings.finding: rms_difference() uses zip and would silently truncate mismatched signatures; callers currently expect ten distances from five points.
findings.next_step: Add equal-length assertions and report candidate count before any signature calculation.

findings.finding: CSV fields are generated from accepted candidates only; rejected-component evidence and full pixel-decoder settings are absent.
findings.next_step: Store full detector config, software versions, all components, and accepted/rejected reasons.

findings.finding: Static review and synthetic self-test do not independently validate the five-dot match, page 57/68 ornament identity, or any cipher relationship.
findings.next_step: Next evidence gate remains source-byte acquisition followed by independent decode and blind full-corpus detection.

conclusion: Static pipeline audit found several reproducibility/inference gaps. The synthetic self-test passed, but no original Liber Primus source pixels were processed and no geometric or cipher result was independently reproduced.
